title: Contradictory evidence revises the frame without resetting context

stages.invocation: Mode: Context dump. SYNTHETIC teaching case. Target: maintenance managers in mid-sized manufacturing plants. Desired outcome: clearer decisions about which conflicting equipment report to investigate next. No actual customer interviews or plant observations exist. Baseline, frequency, financial cost and willingness to pay are UNKNOWN. No browsing, rendering, building, plant control, publishing or other external actions are available. Previous illustrative frame: prioritize conflicting reports. New synthetic interview fixture N1, not a real customer: participants understand the reports but cannot get approval to schedule an investigation. Reportedly the conflict explanation is not the obstacle. Product decision: revise the discovery direction. Keep the same actor and outcome; show changes from the previous frame.

criteria.rule: Revises the hypothesized current condition toward approval or coordination constraints and explains what changed. Does not protect the dashboard solution.
Keeps N1 synthetic/user-reported and does not convert it into verified customer truth or an established root cause.
Reuses actor and outcome, identifies new unknowns and ends at a new human gate; no silent approval.
